q02: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price >= 200000 ORDER BY price DESC
q03: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '2026-%'
q04: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = '아우터'
q05: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31'
q06: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM sales WHERE store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE name = '부산점') AND sale_date LIKE '2026-10-%'
q07: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.sale_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC
q08: SELECT T2.name, SUM(T1.quantity) FROM sales AS T1 INNER JOIN stores AS T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.store_id GROUP BY T2.name
q09: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.channel = '온라인' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.amount) FROM sales AS T1 INNER JOIN stores AS T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.store_id
q10: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.quantity) as total_quantity FROM products p JOIN sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN stores st ON s.store_id = st.store_id WHERE st.channel = '공식몰' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3
q11: SELECT strftime('%m', T1.sale_date) AS month, SUM(T2.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM sales AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id WHERE T2.category = '아우터' AND strftime('%Y', T1.sale_date) = '2026' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
q12: SELECT T2.name AS store_name, T3.category AS category, SUM(T1.amount) AS total_sales FROM sales AS T1 INNER JOIN stores AS T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.store_id INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id WHERE T2.region = '서울' GROUP BY T2.name, T3.category ORDER BY T2.name, T3.category
q13: SELECT category FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC LIMIT 1)
q14: SELECT sale_date, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM sales WHERE sale_date LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1
q15: SELECT s.name AS store_name, p.name AS product_name, MAX(a.amount) AS max_amount FROM sales a JOIN stores s ON a.store_id = s.store_id JOIN products p ON a.product_id = p.product_id WHERE a.sale_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY s.store_id
